description: This file declares an abstract base class and functions related to thread-local storage (TLS) for the functorch component in PyTorch, enabling propagation of specific state information across different parts of the codebase.

classes.name: FuncTorchTLSBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for thread-local storage used by functorch, providing virtual methods for deep copy and support checks.

methods.name: deepcopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the functorch TLS instance.

methods.name: checkSupportsSingleLevelAutogradFunction
methods.description: Checks if single-level autograd functions are supported.

methods.name: checkSupportsCppAutogradFunction
methods.description: Checks if C++ autograd functions are supported.

methods.name: checkSupportsInplaceRequiresGrad
methods.description: Checks if in-place requires_grad is supported.
